author: ASAD00
quote: Rockstar Games once held an undisputed reputation for delivering narrative masterpieces and unrivaled open-world freedom. Titles like GTA: Vice City, GTA: San Andreas, and GTA V set the gold standard for gaming. They blended compelling, cinematic stories with an incredible sense of agency, allowing players to cause chaotic, unscripted fun whenever they stepped into the world. Unfortunately, their latest release falls drastically short of that legacy.
